changelog: Edited [Priority Rules] to reorder and explicitly demote boundaries that risk premature commitment: splits that separate evaluative/conditional cues (still, seems, not, unless, if, etc.), separate a pronoun/possessive from its eventual antecedent/head noun, separate subject and its finite verb (risking agreement), cut off a noun phrase before a possible head noun interrupted by parenthesis/apposition, and separate auxiliaries/modals from their complements are now ranked lower. This reduces 'placement' errors by ensuring those positions are considered less confident.
Left all other sections unchanged to preserve existing candidacy coverage and the frozen [Output Rules].
